item.title: #005 (Snippet) — Adding `view-transition-class` turns list filtering from an …
item.description: Adding `view-transition-class` turns list filtering from an abrupt hide/show snap into archival index cards gliding cleanly along a rail — all in under ten lines of CSS.

item.title: #004 (Question) — Once `llms.txt` and clean `index.md` twins give AI agents a …
item.description: Once `llms.txt` and clean `index.md` twins give AI agents a dedicated high-signal channel, can human-facing HTML finally stop flattening itself into plain text and become a tactile visual medium again? [2026-11-24] This thread grew into Issue 05, complete with an interactive Human/Agent Representation Inspector.

item.title: #003 (Quote) — A steady reminder whenever the urge strikes to wrap a contro…
item.description: “Weniger, aber besser — Less, but better.” A steady reminder whenever the urge strikes to wrap a control in one more border or slap a status dot on a heading. Restraint isn't scarcity; it lets typography and whitespace carry the room.

item.title: #002 (Musing) — An idea written in Chinese often lands with aphoristic compr…
item.description: An idea written in Chinese often lands with aphoristic compression, yet translating it into idiomatic English immediately exposes every unspoken premise. Bilingual publishing isn't just wider reach — it's a built-in calibration mirror for thought.

item.title: #001 (Musing) — First studio note on the ledger: no bundler, no runtime fram…
item.description: First studio note on the ledger: no bundler, no runtime framework. Ten years from now, on any machine that can still open a browser, double-clicking these plain HTML and Markdown files should still read cleanly.
